blocks.text: DALLAS — Rookie Darius Acuff Jr. scored 25 points and the Sacramento Kings won for the first time in seven games this NBA season, beating the Dallas Mavericks 115-100 on Monday night. Malik Monk added 24 points and Zach LaVine had 23 for the Kings, the last NBA team this season to win.
